text: {"442":{"about":["rustc_expand","rustc_resolve"],"refers":[],"why":"Macro expansion is implemented by rustc_expand, while the deferred name resolution is performed by rustc_resolve."},"443":{"about":["rustc_expand","rustc_builtin_macros"],"refers":[],"why":"rustc_expand supports eager argument expansion and rustc_builtin_macros implements the special built-ins that use it."},"444":{"about":["rustc_expand"],"refers":[],"why":"The lazy expansion order described is behavior of the macro-expansion machinery."},"445":{"about":["rustc_expand"],"refers":[],"why":"The eager expansion order described is behavior of the macro-expansion machinery."},"446":{"about":["rustc_expand","rustc_builtin_macros"],"refers":[],"why":"The restriction of eager expansion to special built-ins is enforced by expansion support and built-in macro implementations."}}
